column1: # Bilingual glossary: Kiswahili term -> English search words (one entry per line, tab-separated).
# Used for cross-lingual retrieval: the official documents are in English, so a Kiswahili
# question is searched with these English words added and the matched Kiswahili words removed.
#   domain: registration | compliance | taxation | social_security | health_social | financing | general
#   reviewed: blank = draft; put the reviewer's initials and date once a Kiswahili speaker has checked it
# Matching is on whole words, longest entry first, lowercase. Keep entries in plain words (no punctuation).
mfuko wa taifa wa hifadhi ya jamii
# A leading * marks a ROOT matched inside a word (nitasajili, tutasajili, kusajiliwa -> sajili).
# Roots are checked only on words no phrase above has used. English "-" means: drop the word
# from the search (filler verbs such as "need", "can", "get", which only add noise).
